_doc: Cabin style presets. 'positive' must contain {prompt}; 'negative' is appended to the user's negative prompt. Optional: 'strength' (restyle default), 'cfg', 'steps', 'lora' (reserved). Override by copying this file to <pyre store>/cabin/styles.json.

styles.name: No style
styles.positive: {prompt}

styles.name: Studio Ghibli
styles.positive: {prompt}, studio ghibli style, hayao miyazaki, hand-painted anime background, soft watercolor shading, warm natural light, lush details
styles.negative: photo, 3d render, realistic, harsh lighting, lowres
